method: Same Chromium / AMD RX6600, desktop 1440x950, 3-second curved native mouse drag, 180 moves. Spatial filtering unchanged; cube accepts 91 points and emits 61 exact radius/4 dabs. Source geometry/strength and coordinates match. Initial baseline collected before edits; matched baseline rerun from isolated Git archive, never by resetting current source. Capture-phase input timestamps and real 128x128 terrain-frame readback (no UI overlay) verify changed pixels. Sampling CPU profile covers main thread only; categories include descendants without double counting. Probes/profiling add measurement overhead. Warm-up/JIT and system activity cause variance; report both initial and warmed baseline, not only the slowest run. Final cube rows rerun without overlapping numerical jobs. Mature reference source remained unchanged; their uncontented initial/matched-baseline rows are the comparison, and a corrected-pass reference run that overlapped numerical tests is retained but not used as a performance claim.
